methodology.sampling: stratified largest-first + seeded random (seed=20261123): common/units 6L+6R, common/naval 12(all), nation buildings 9L+9R, nation units 9L+9R
methodology.fix: set RGB=(0,0,0) ONLY where alpha==0; all other pixels (including semi-transparent 0<alpha<255) preserved byte-for-byte in value
methodology.encoder: Pillow PNG, default settings (no optimize) - matches the bake scripts' plain save()/render output; before=original file bytes, after=zeroed re-save bytes, control=untouched re-save bytes
methodology.control_purpose: isolate encoder/metadata re-save overhead from the true zeroing effect (saved_vs_control)
methodology.asset_edits: none; all re-saves written to a temp dir then deleted

project_wide_estimate.method: scale sample savings ratio to all 1849 PNGs' total bytes
project_wide_estimate.caveat: extrapolation from 60 of 1849 sheets (3.2%); per-stratum mix and file sizes vary, treat as order-of-magnitude estimate

semi_transparency.note: zeroing is gated strictly on alpha==0, so any semi-transparent pixel is preserved exactly; if this list is empty no sheet uses semi-transparency and full RGB zeroing under alpha==0 is lossless
